title: Identification of indocyanine green as a STT3B inhibitor against mushroom α-amanitin cytotoxicity
model: HAP1 cells, Brunello genome-wide knockout library
contrast: α-amanitin vs PBS, 7 days (2 vs 2), median-ratio totals
paper_calls: 559 genes at p < 0.05 and |LFC| > 1 (10 at MAGeCK FDR 0.10); STT3B and MGAT1 in the top 10
barcs_calls: 17 genes at FDR 0.10, all enriched (8 against the control null); 8 with library totals
named_hits: 2/5 at FDR 0.10 (MGAT1 #2, STT3B #9); ALG10, STT3A and RPN2 not enriched in raw counts
verdict: BARCS recovers the paper's core resistance genes (MGAT1, STT3B, WDR81, TAF4, SPPL3, SLC46A3) and 8 of its 10 MAGeCK FDR 0.10 genes, but not the other N-glycan genes the paper cites, whose raw counts do not rise under α-amanitin.
